changelog: D~C@T: new name and kitten logo; the app is a fork of AntiGem by Santosh Kurmi (GPL-3.0).

Agentic browser is on by default: after you sign in, the in-app Browser Automation and Google Flow MCP servers are added to both Antigravity and Claude Code. Turn it off in Settings > Automation & Device Tools. Servers you remove or disable stay that way.
Live models: the model list and quotas refresh every 5 minutes and whenever you come back to the app. Models the server has but the app didn't list before now show up.
New models are switched on automatically when they first appear, while models you switched off stay off.
Accent colours: pick Amber, Kitten (black and white like the logo), Ocean, Violet, Emerald, Rose or Teal in Settings > Appearance & Theme, alongside Light, Dark or System mode.
In-app updates now check the D~C@T repository (Danish797035/DCAT) instead of the original AntiGem one.
